elements.name: small town strung along the top of a high green ridge
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs
small terraced fields on steep slopes
mist in the deep valleys below
layered mountains fading into blue haze

wrong_setting: The houses have red-orange pitched tile-style roofs and the trees are columnar poplars/cypresses, which read as a Mediterranean or European hill village rather than an Ethiopian highland town with corrugated tin roofs and eucalyptus.
notes: Repaint the houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs, swap the poplar and cypress shapes for tall wispy eucalyptus, and move the town onto the crest of a ridge in the centre of the frame.
